Direction to the venue

From Anthony Village Bus Stop to Apostolic Faith Secondary School via Campground Rd.

6 min (1.1 km)

1. Head west on Anthony Village Rd toward Faramobi Ajike St
2. Turn right onto Faramobi Ajike St
3. Turn right onto Bola St
4. Turn left onto Olorunlogbon St
5. Turn right onto Ladipo Olukoya St
6. Turn left onto Oyedele Ogunniyi St
7. Turn right onto Jide Adeniyi St
8. Turn left onto Adebayo Mokuolu St
9. Turn right onto Deji Odunuga St
10. Turn left onto Saji Ayangade St
11. Turn right onto Campground Rd
12. Arrive at location: Apostolic Faith Secondary School
